title: The one-card tarot spread
description: How the one-card tarot spread works: how to lay it out, which questions suit it, a worked example, and when a single card is enough.

scenes.headline: The one-card tarot spread
scenes.caption: The one-card tarot spread is one question and one card. It is the quickest way to start reading tarot.
scenes.vo: The one-card tarot spread is one question and one card. It is the quickest way to start reading tarot.

scenes.headline: How the one-card spread works
scenes.caption: You shuffle the deck while holding a question in mind, then turn over a single card. The card's position is the question itself, so there is nothing else to remember.
scenes.vo: How the one-card spread works. You shuffle the deck while holding a question in mind, then turn over a single card. The card's position is the question itself, so there is nothing else to remember.

scenes.headline: How to lay it out
scenes.caption: Choose a question, shuffle, draw one card, then read it.
